Temperature Module Thermocycler Useful Types Execute and Simulate Table of Contents Description Structure of this manual Introduction Welcome to the instruction manual for the Opentrons OT-2 liquid handling robot. This manual will help you set up and work with the OT-2. Description ¶ The OT-2 automates routine liquid-handling work in your lab. It is a modular system that includes user-swappable pipettes, on-deck modules, and labware. You control the OT-2 through the Opentrons OT-2 App , our open-source Python API , and through protocols created in the Opentrons Protocol Designer . Structure of this manual ¶ This manual is organized to help you get started quickly and operate your OT-2 efficiently. Feel free to jump into the chapters that interest you most, or review the manual from beginning to end. Here is a summary of what you will find inside: Getting started : If you are new to liquid handling robots, or simply unsure where to begin, start with System Description and Installation and Relocation . These sections cover the OT-2's components, technical specifications, and how to set up and operate the robot for the first time. Control the robot : The Opentrons OT-2 App section describes how to download and use this software to operate and manage your OT-2. Work with instruments and modules : Attaching pipettes and modules to the OT-2 gives it the flexibility to handle a range of liquid handling tasks. See the OT-2 Pipettes section and the OT-2 Modules section for technical specifications and instructions on how to attach these components to your robot. Use labware : The Labware section describes compatible labware and how to use it in the Opentrons OT-2 App and on the deck. Keep OT-2 running : Following the user-level procedures in the Maintenance section helps ensure that your robot has a long and trouble-free life. And more! For other topics, see the Appendices. Here you can find more information about Opentrons and writing code to control your OT-2. © Opentrons 2026. All rights reserved.
